operationUnit: one retained complete addition result; direct performs one binary addition and chained performs two left-associated binary additions
specification: Select two string operands from a runtime-dependent mixed owned/literal pool, then use actual string + and retain the complete result. Operands remain reusable. All UTF8 content and output order are observable.
notes: Input cloning/repetition, operand selection, actual additions and complete output retention are timed. Observation runs outside timing. Native additions produce independent owned strings, including the chained intermediate; JavaScript may use immutable ropes or shared storage. Literal-only correctness cells are separate from throughput. No coordinate conversion, custom storage, isolated-call latency or equal allocation claim.
